lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the shadow of the mountain high,
A silver moon hangs in the velvet sky.
The wind whispers secrets to the ancient stone,
She walks the path of the wild alone.
[Pre-Chorus]
The embers glow with a hidden fire,
Rising higher in the spirit's choir.
[Chorus]
Rise from the dust of the ages past,
Find the light that is built to last.
Through the storm and the valley wide,
Carry the flame that burns inside.
[Verse]
He stands where the iron meets the earth,
A warrior’s grace in a moment of birth.
His heart beats steady like a rolling drum,
Waiting for the glory that is yet to come.
[Pre-Chorus]
The shadows stretch across the plain,
Washing away the fear and pain.
[Chorus]
Rise from the dust of the ages past,
Find the light that is built to last.
Through the storm and the valley wide,
Carry the flame that burns inside.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
One final stand beneath the fading sun,
The battle won, the journey just begun.
[Chorus]
Rise from the dust of the ages past,
Find the light that is built to last.
Through the storm and the valley wide,
Carry the flame that burns inside.
[Outro]
